# Map feasibility spike T1–T6 (deliverable 5)

**All geometry, tiles, control points and images are synthetic test fixtures** (generated by `spike/generate_fixtures.py`). Open http://localhost:3000/dev/map-spike: the page runs every test in your browser and shows a PASS/FAIL table. Playwright asserts the same results (`frontend/e2e/map-spike.spec.ts`).

Screenshot from the cloud run: [evidence/map-spike-cloud-chrome.png](evidence/map-spike-cloud-chrome.png)

| Test | Expected | Actual (cloud workspace, headless Google Chrome) | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T1 Earth | OpenFreeMap "liberty" style loads; synthetic RFC 7946 outline at 0–1°E/N drawn; OSM attribution | `AJAXError: Failed to fetch … tiles.openfreemap.org` — the workspace network blocks that host | **NOT VERIFIED** (environment); must pass on the Mac |
| T2 Mars | Map in IAU_2015:49910, tile matrix ABAAD-MarsEqcQuad (origin −10,669,445.6 / +10,669,445.6 m, extent 21,338,891.1 m, 512-px tiles, z 0–3), drawn without reprojection | projection = IAU_2015:49910; synthetic tiles drawn | PASS |
| T3 Overlay | WKT polygon + 3 control points within 1 source pixel of the raster, for both the main-thread converter and the worker (GeoJSON) path | max offset 0.71 px raster and 0.71 px overlay at zooms 1–3; polygon vertices 4/4 on both. The 0.71 px is a systematic half-pixel (0.5, 0.5) from marker centring; within tolerance. | PASS |
| T4 CRS mismatch | Adding Web Mercator tiles to the Mars map is refused by code | `CrsMismatchError`: EPSG:3857 ≠ IAU_2015:49910; source not added; message shown | PASS |
| T5 Moon | Static south-polar panel; graticule and scale from the lunar radius match pyproj | IAU_2015:30135, R = 1,737,400 m; max deviation 2.9e-11 m; 100 km bar (true at pole; k = 1.0077 at 80°S) | PASS |
| T6 Scale | No Earth scale control on Mars; scale from the Mars radius | computed 5,209.7 m/px at z3 = measured 5,209.7 (0.000%); Earth scale control absent | PASS |

## Fallback decision
- **Earth:** interactive MapLibre, pending T1 on your Mac.
- **Mars:** an interactive custom-CRS map is *feasible* (T2–T4 and T6 pass), but MapLibre marks custom CRS as **experimental**. Recommendation: keep MapLibre pinned at 6.18.0, and keep static pre-rendered Mars panels as the documented fallback if a MapLibre update breaks T2–T6.
- **Moon south pole:** static panel, as planned. No interactive polar map in the MVP.
- The science engine does not depend on MapLibre.
